name: 6-chloro-MDMA
summary: 6-Chloro-MDMA, also known as 6-chloro-3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine or as 2-chloro-4,5-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine (2-Cl-4,5-MDMA), is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families related to MDMA. It is the 6-chloro derivative of MDMA. The drug has been identified both in seized "ecstasy" tablets and in urine samples from drug users.

pharmacology.text: It is thought most likely to be an impurity from synthesis and its pharmacological properties have not been established; however, it has been banned in several countries.
